thread:
morgan: Spawning a dedicated thread for postmortem follow-ups on the authz outage. Goal: assign owners, set non-ambiguous deadlines, and establish a short-term cadence for remediation until the issues are closed. Reply with 'take' + date or 'blocker: ...'.

ashley: take token validation tests + synthetic monitor. Need a test SA and a staging hook to run nightly. Proposed due 2026-04-10.

kevin: take audit ingestion hardening. Plan: strict schema validation at the consumer, metric for dropped events, and an alert rule. ETA 2026-04-03.

priya: take secrets rotation automation and emergency playbook. I want to do cron + k8s job + vault rotate with dry-run + fast rollback. ETA 2026-04-20 but might need infra coordination.

izzy: take permissions drift detection and nightly reconciliation job against canonical policy. ETA 2026-04-14.

ben: I'll update the incident runbook and add a short "how to detect recurrence" appendix plus oncall checklist entries. ETA 2026-04-06.

ops-bot: Reminder: morgan scheduled weekly follow-ups until tasks are closed.

morgan: Recap -> owners: ashley (token tests/synthetic) 04-10; kevin (audit ingestion + alerts) 04-03; priya (rotation + playbook) 04-20; izzy (perm-drift) 04-14; ben (runbook) 04-06. Weekly 30m sync proposed Fridays 09:30 PT until cleared.

ashley: Synthetic outline (WIP): exercise issuance, refresh, malformed token, expired token. Will add a test account request. Example check: ```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://authz.internal/validate | jq .status
```
I'll post job YAML in the ticket.

kevin: Schema validator sketch: ```python
required = ["user_id","token_id","action","ts","svc"]
def valid(evt):
    return all(k in evt and evt[k] for k in required)
```
Will wire metric: authz.audit.dropped_count and alert on >5 drops / 5m or >0.1% of volume.

priya: Emergency rotation playbook (draft): 1) switch service to degraded; 2) run rotate-secrets --env prod --dry-run; 3) promote rotated to canary; 4) smoke test 15m; 5) promote or rollback. Will add scripts for fast rollback and notification hooks.

izzy: For drift detection I'll compare live IAM policies to baseline JSON in git and raise PRs or alerts on diffs. Prototype will produce a short remediation plan per finding.

ben: Runbook sections I'll add: TL;DR, immediate triage steps, postmortem links, metrics to check (token-parse-errors, audit drops, rotation failures), rollback steps, and owners matrix.

morgan: Ops asks: can infra enable a two-week detailed audit retention window for high-fidelity debugging? If infra agrees we'll revert to normal retention after remediation.

ops-bot: Ticket created: AUTHZ-1524 (audit retention bump) -> infra-team.

ashley: blocker: need a staging test SA; who is the infra contact?

priya: I can coordinate access but will need a brief infra sync.

kevin: I'll attach test vectors and a small dataset to the ticket so validation can be exercised in CI.

morgan: Good. Next steps: I'll create epics/cards and add these tickets. Owners, please post progress 24h before each weekly sync. If ETA slips, flag sooner so we can adjust. Weekly sync: Fridays 09:30 PT starting next week. :white_check_mark:

ashley: ack - posting job YAML and SA req today.

kevin: ack - linking AUTHZ-1492 + PR before sync.

priya: ack - will post playbook draft by Friday EOD.

izzy: ack - will drop prototype results to the ticketing thread.

ben: ack - runbook update PR planned for 04-05.

morgan: Thanks everyone. Pinning this thread to the incident ticket and sprinkling the runbook with the detection signals we agreed on (token parse errors, audit gaps, rotation timeouts). We'll re-evaluate cadence after two weeks.
